name: Slice Chef
summary:
Cooking has never been this dangerous! Slice Chef brings the addictive thrill of 'survivor' style games to VR.

It’s harvest time, but the crops are fighting back. Set in a vibrant farm world, you must help your determined little chef fend off an endless army of mutant vegetables. Tomatoes, cucumbers, and eggplants are swarming from every direction, and the only way out is to slice through them!
